name: SikaBond-145 SuperGrip
paste:
SIKABOND®-145 SUPERGRIP: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip, September 2025, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sikabond-145-supergrip.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2025, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip is a premium grade one-component polyurethane construction adhesive with good initial grab and high strength after 30 minutes^. SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip is a versatile, fast curing, general purpose construction adhesive suitable for interior and exterior use.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip is suitable for use in construction and repair applications where a permanent strong bond is required between porous-nonporous surfaces. Suitable for bonding common construction materials such as:
    - Wood & MDF
    - Concrete & fibre cement
    - Brick & blocks
    - Metal & aluminium
    - Polystrene
    - Polyurethane foam
    - Some PVC
    - Marble & stone
    - Granite
    - Ceramic tile
    - LOSP Timber
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.6.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: FAST CURING PREMIUM POLYURETHANE CONSTRUCTION ADHESIVE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (September 2025, Version 01.03) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - DIN 53479: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Density (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - One-component
    - Interior & exterior
    - Non-shrink
    - Non-sag
    - High initial grab
    - Strong bond
    - Adheres rapidly
    - Stong bond in 30 minutes^
    - Fast curing
    - Solvent-free
    - Resistant to heat
    - Resistant to weathering
    - Applies white, can dry translucent if applied in thin layers
    ^See Curing time below.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polyurethane
    - Colour: Applies white (may dry translucent if applied if thin layers)
    - Density: ~1.15 g/cm³ (DIN 53479)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Service temperature: -30° C to +100° C
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 310ml Cartridge
    - Shelf life: 12 months if storage conditions are met.
    - Storage conditions: SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip stored in original, unopened packaging in cool, dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. All surfaces must be clean and free from all dust, laitance, scale, rust, loose particles, grease and foreign matter.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Open Time: Relocation time is approximately 5~10 minutues depending on temperature and ventilation.
4.3 Curing time. Approximately 30 minutes for initial bond strength, depending on temperature, moisture content of surfaces and adhesive thickness. Some non-porous substrates (such as metal) may require 1 hour to reach initial bond strength. Strength will increase over the next 24 hours.
4.4 Application method / tools. 1. Cut end off cartridge nozzle at a 45° angle to give a 5- 6 mm bead. 2. Fit cartridge into a suitable Sika gun. 3. Apply adhesive in thin layers to one surface, or both surfaces if they are both very porous or absorbent. 4. Join surfaces within 5 minutes. A perfect fit is required for a watertight bond. 5. Clamp the substrates during adhesive cure. Clamp time is 30 minutes at +15°C to +20°C. Clamp for longer if the temperature is below +10°C or if the substrate is damp or non-porous. 6. Remove clamp when sufficient bond strength is achieved.
4.5 Cleaning of equipment. Clean up tools and equipment with acetone or white spirit. Cured adhesive can only be removed mechanically.
4.6 Limitations and important considerations.
    - One or both of the materials to be bonded must be porous.
    - For non-porous substrates such as metal clamp for 1 hour.
    - A perfect fit of components is required for a watertight bond.
    - Surfaces may be damp or slightly moist, but all free liquid water must be removed.
    - Fastest bond time will be achieved with dry substrates. It is best practice to increase the clamp time when using damp materials.
    - Do not expose to direct sunlight or temperatures above 50°C or to freezing temperatures. Keep the product within the specified storage conditions.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.6):
    - Do not expose to direct sunlight or temperatures above 50°C or to freezing temperatures. Keep the product within the specified storage conditions.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Density: ~1.15 g/cm³ (DIN 53479)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaBond®-145 SuperGrip, September 2025, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sikabond-145-supergrip.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaBond 145 Supergrip, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/MSDS%20SikaBond-145%20Supergrip%20GHS7.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaBond 145 SuperGrip Flyer, version 31/08/2021, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/Leaflet_Sikaflex-145%20SuperGrip%20AU%202021%20FIN%20DIGITAL.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
